characters.name: Iwakaze
characters.ability: Once per opponent turn, when an attack made with Push dice would deal you 2 or more damage while you control a dohyō position, prevent 1 of that damage.
characters.art: An enormous, stern veteran in an indigo mawashi with folded arms, Mount Fuji, stylised indigo waves and golden evening cloud.

characters.name: Arashiryū
characters.ability: Once on your turn, if your final dice show 3 or more Push symbols, add 1 damage to your dice attack.
characters.art: A fierce young rikishi in a crimson mawashi launching a low tachiai charge, vermilion lightning-like brushstrokes and flying dust.

characters.name: Hoshinoumi
characters.ability: Once on your turn, when your numbered dice earn at least 1 Prestige, gain 1 additional Prestige.
characters.art: A charismatic confident rikishi in a purple mawashi with an open-palmed showman pose, lilac banners, star shapes and cheering supporters.

characters.name: Chiyonami
characters.ability: Once on your turn, after your two normal reroll opportunities, you may reroll exactly one die and must accept its new result.
characters.art: A relatively lean nimble rikishi in a dark green mawashi crouched low in a poised stance, bamboo and a breaking emerald wave.

characters.name: Akatsukifuji
characters.ability: Once on your turn, if at least one Recovery die actually restores Stamina, restore 1 additional Stamina, up to 10.
characters.art: A broad cheerful rikishi in a mustard/gold mawashi, holding a steaming chanko-nabe bowl, lanterns and golden celebratory pattern.

characters.name: Tetsunishiki
characters.ability: Once on your turn, if your Spirit dice grant you 1 or more Fighting Spirit, gain 1 additional Fighting Spirit.
characters.art: A weathered older veteran rikishi in a turquoise mawashi, strong craggy face, pine trees, ocean-blue ink clouds and restrained gold.

cards.name: Tachiai Charge
cards.effect: Once on your turn, if your final dice show 3 or more Push symbols, add 1 damage to your dice attack.
cards.art: A red-mawashi wrestler exploding forward at the opening charge, forceful red-gold speed lines.

cards.name: Mawashi Grip
cards.effect: Once on your turn, after all rerolls, you may change one die showing 1 to Push.
cards.art: Close-up hands gripping a blue sumo mawashi, tense dramatic fabric folds, indigo and brass.

cards.name: Clay Footing
cards.effect: Once per opponent turn, prevent 1 damage from the first dice attack that hits you while you control a dohyō position.
cards.art: Feet digging into clay near the straw tawara ring edge, cracked earth and dust, ochre.

cards.name: Extra Keiko
cards.effect: Once on your turn, after your normal rerolls, you may reroll exactly one die and must accept its result.
cards.art: Rikishi performing a powerful high-leg shiko training stomp in a stable, emerald and gold.

cards.name: Chanko Recipe
cards.effect: Once on your turn, if at least one Recovery die actually restores Stamina, restore 1 additional Stamina, up to 10.
cards.art: Steaming traditional chanko-nabe meal in an iron pot with tofu, cabbage and broth, warm lantern glow.

cards.name: Senior Rank
cards.effect: When you start your turn controlling a dohyō position, gain 1 extra Prestige in addition to the normal 2.
cards.art: Ornate vertical banzuke ranking scroll without readable writing, gold braided tassels.

cards.name: Crowd Chant
cards.effect: Once on your turn, when numbered dice earn at least 1 Prestige, gain 1 additional Prestige.
cards.art: Excited tournament spectators calling out and waving patterned fans, indigo and purple crowd.

cards.name: Salt Ritual
cards.effect: Once on your turn, if your Spirit dice grant at least 1 Fighting Spirit, gain 1 additional Fighting Spirit.
cards.art: Rikishi throwing a dazzling white arc of purification salt before a bout, violet smoky background.

cards.name: Stable Support
cards.effect: At the end of your turn, if you are outside both dohyō positions and have 7 or fewer Stamina, recover 1 Stamina.
cards.art: An older stablemaster coaching a younger rikishi beside practice posts, warm wooden stable.

cards.name: Fierce Rivalry
cards.effect: Once on your turn, when you take an empty dohyō position after resolving your Push dice attack, gain 1 additional Prestige.
cards.art: Two imposing rikishi glaring at each other before the tachiai, red and blue split composition.

cards.name: Chanko Feast
cards.effect: Immediately recover 3 Stamina, even if you control a dohyō position. You cannot exceed 10 Stamina.
cards.art: Huge bubbling chanko-nabe hotpot surrounded by rice bowls and chopsticks, steam.

cards.name: Zabuton Storm
cards.effect: Immediately gain 3 Prestige.
cards.art: Red floor cushions flying over jubilant sumo spectators in a packed arena.

cards.name: Kachi-koshi
cards.effect: Immediately gain 5 Prestige.
cards.art: Triumphant rikishi holding a giant ornate golden tournament trophy beneath falling confetti.

cards.name: Sponsor’s Envelope
cards.effect: Immediately gain 4 Fighting Spirit (after paying this card’s cost).
cards.art: Ceremonial envelopes and traditional embroidered sponsorship banners, gold and deep navy.

cards.name: Shikiri Reset
cards.effect: Immediately recover 2 Stamina and gain 1 Prestige.
cards.art: Rikishi crouching quietly at shikiri lines, soft dust, focused eyes and amber lanterns.

cards.name: Henka!
cards.effect: Choose one opponent controlling a dohyō position. They lose 3 Stamina. This is not a dice attack and does not allow them to retreat.
cards.art: One nimble wrestler sidestepping a charging heavier rival, sweeping diagonal motion lines.

cards.name: Tsuppari Flurry
cards.effect: Every opponent on the opposite side of the ring boundary from you loses 2 Stamina. This is not a dice attack and cannot cause a retreat.
cards.art: Rapid-fire open-hand thrusts in an arena, repeated hands and energetic red screen-print lines.

cards.name: Ceremonial Entrance
cards.effect: If you control a dohyō position, gain 2 Prestige. Otherwise, gain 1 Prestige and 1 Fighting Spirit.
cards.art: Magnificent ring-entering ceremony, colourful kesho-mawashi apron and ceremonial rope.

cards.name: Suriashi Drills
cards.effect: Immediately recover 2 Stamina and gain 1 Fighting Spirit. Healing works even in a dohyō position.
cards.art: Low sliding-foot training exercise in a wooden stable with chalk lines and sweat.

cards.name: Final Bout
cards.effect: Choose one opponent. They lose 2 Stamina, and you gain 1 Prestige. This is not a dice attack and cannot cause a retreat.
cards.art: High-drama final bout under arena spotlights, two sumo wrestlers locked in a mawashi grapple.
